capabilities: add tags to new notes based on their vault path
configure path-to-tag mappings with glob patterns
extras: README is minimal: it documents one config option (a path-to-tag mapping in simplified Glob format) but gives no screenshots, examples of the mapping syntax beyond the config sample, or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian creates new notes untagged, so users have to add tags manually or keep folder-based organization out of the tag system.
summary: Path-based tagging plugin that adds tags to newly created notes automatically according to configurable glob-style folder patterns.
